messages.author: 24de6a9fdc0a14c0
messages.subject: [Request] Upgrade GDAL version (>= 2.0.0)
parts:
I tried to publish my shiny app but the process failed and threw the following error:

[2016-11-18T20:47:27.895460871+0000] Building R package: sf (0.2-4)
/mnt/packages/build /mnt
Warning in untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :
  skipping pax global extended headers
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *source* package ‘sf’ ...
configure: CC: gcc -std=gnu99
configure: CXX: g++
configure: : 
checking for gdal-config... /usr/bin/gdal-config
checking gdal-config usability... yes
configure: GDAL: 1.10.1
checking GDAL version >= 2.0.0... no
configure: error: sf is not compatible with GDAL versions below 2.0.0
ERROR: configuration failed for package ‘sf’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/sf’
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 297743120 failed: Error building image: Error building sf (0.2-4). Build exited with non-zero status: 1
Execution halted

It seems that the shinyapps.io GDAL version is incompatible with the sf package. 

Unfortunately, my shiny app is built around the sf package and it would require substantial resources to go back and adapt the entire thing to sp.

Do you have any plans to update GDAL? If so, what would a realistic timeframe be? I'd like to update my manager and set some expectations on the delay.

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] [Request] Upgrade GDAL version (>= 2.0.0)
parts:
The issue with GDAL 2.x is that its not supported on Ubuntu 12.04 which our containers are still running by default. That said we've taken on some work to add support for Ubuntu 16.04, but I'm not sure of the status. You may be able to opt in to using 16.04 (which should have a newer GDAL).

Stay tuned and we'll figure what, if anything, can be done.
